subject: MAP Draft: Integration build plan — SDK integration, streaming, tool calling, structured outputs
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Harris <tom.harris@acme-corp.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: MAP Draft: Integration build plan — SDK integration, streaming, tool calling, structured outputs

Hi Tom / Samantha —

Thanks again for the time today. Per our call, attached is the first draft of the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focusing on the integration build plan milestone. The goal here is to make the technical scope and owners explicit so we can validate timelines and dependencies ahead of procurement.

High-level summary / ask:
- Target close date: 2026-12-15 (we proposed a 4-week pilot + production roll path).
- MAP milestone: Integration build plan (this doc) — covers SDK integration, streaming setup, tool-calling hooks, and structured output schema.
- Please review owners and dependencies; flag anything missing by EOD Tuesday so we can freeze the MAP for the proposal.

Key milestones in the draft (see attached PDF and owner matrix):
1) SDK integration (client-side auth, batching, and retry semantics) — Owner: Acme (integration team) + Redwood SDK lead (Vivek).
2) Streaming & chunking config (ws/http-streaming, reconnection behavior) — Owner: Redwood runtime (Neha) with Acme latency targets.
3) Tool calling & function hooks (external search, ticket creation) — Owner: Acme product + Redwood product (Rachel).
4) Structured outputs (JSON schema for entity extraction / tool routing) — Owner: Acme data team + Redwood ML eng (Marissa).

Dependencies we've noted:
- Access to a staging AWS account and service role for SDK testing (Acme IT).
- Sample dataset for structured output validation (Acme Data).
- SLA & rate targets (to size Dedicated vs Hosted recommendations).

Attachments: redwood_map_draft_v1.pdf (MAP draft), integration_owner_matrix.xlsx (owner/responsibility matrix).

Next steps:
1) Review and mark edits in the Google Drive copy (link below).
2) Confirm technical owners and staging access by 2026-11-24.
3) We’ll circulate a final MAP and proposed SOW the week of 2026-11-30.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-MAP-RDW-ACME
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
[Attachment: redwood_map_draft_v1.pdf]
[Attachment: integration_owner_matrix.xlsx]

From: Tom Harris <tom.harris@acme-corp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme-corp.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP Draft: Integration build plan — SDK integration, streaming, tool calling, structured outputs

Marissa —

Appreciate the clear draft and the owner matrix. Quick feedback from our side after an initial review:

- Target close date: 2026-12-15 looks aggressive but possible; can we confirm pilot success criteria (latency p95 < 300ms, 99% availability for test traffic) so our infra team signs off?
- SDK integration: We need explicit guidance on connection reuse / long-lived streams. Our mobile team prefers short-lived connections; can the SDK support both patterns?
- Tool calling: We have an internal search API (search.acme-corp.com) that will need to be proxied through your tool-calling interface. Will Redwood support token-based short-lived credentials for that?
- Dependencies: We can provide a staging AWS account by 11/23, but the service role will be limited until procurement completes.

I’ll loop in our engineering lead if we need deeper implementation details. For now, please mark the SDK and streaming items as blockers until we agree on connection patterns and credentials.

Thanks —
Tom Harris
Director, Platform Integrations | Acme Corp
[tom.harris@acme-corp.com]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Harris <tom.harris@acme-corp.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-19T08:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP Draft: Integration build plan — SDK integration, streaming, tool calling, structured outputs

Tom —

Great questions. Short answers and proposed updates to the MAP (I’ll update the Drive copy and owner matrix today):

1) Pilot success criteria: We’ll add explicit SLI/SLOs to the MAP (p95 latency target, availability target, sample QPS). Proposal: p95 < 300ms for interactive flows, 99.5% availability during pilot. If that works, we’ll include in SOW.

2) SDK connection patterns: Redwood SDK supports both short-lived connections (HTTP request/response with streaming chunked responses) and long-lived websocket streams with reconnect logic and automatic KV cache warm-up. Action: Vivek will document recommended patterns for mobile vs server.

3) Tool calling & credentials: We support short-lived token exchange via our brokered-auth pattern (we’ll provide the flow diagram). Action: Rachel to own the tool-calling integration plan with Acme (she’ll map end-points and token exchange responsibilities).

4) Staging access: Thanks — 11/23 for a staging account is fine; note limited role will constrain some runtime tests (we can run SDK + mock search proxy to validate integration).

I’m attaching a quick owner snapshot here (see integration_owner_matrix.xlsx in Drive). Proposed owners (short):
- SDK integration: Acme mobile + Vivek (Redwood) — owner email: vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com
- Streaming config: Neha (Redwood runtime) — owner email: neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com
- Tool calling: Rachel (Redwood product) + Acme product — owner email: rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com
- Structured outputs: Marissa (Redwood ML eng) + Acme data — owner email: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com

Next steps: I’ll update the Drive MAP with the SLI/SLO rows and connection patterns today; please confirm if the proposed pilot criteria above look okay.

Thanks —
Marissa
[Attachment: integration_owner_matrix.xlsx]

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: MAP Draft: Integration build plan — SDK integration, streaming, tool calling, structured outputs

Thanks Marissa —

I reviewed the owner snapshot and added two small clarifications in the Drive sheet:
- For SDK integration, add a deliverable: sample mobile SDK integration guide (owner: Vivek) by 2026-11-30.
- For Tool calling, we should document the token-exchange sequence and a test harness (owner: Rachel) by 2026-12-02.

I’ll also prepare a short mutual action plan summary for procurement to speed up the SOW sign-off. If Acme can confirm staging access + token exchange requirements by 11/24, we should be on track for the 12/15 target.

Rachel Kim
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
